submission.natural_language_explanation: This direction encodes plural grammatical number for the noun phrase under construction: it sits at zero on singular NPs ('The bird', 'The doctor'), on disjunction ('X or Y') and on a bare modifier ('X near Y'), rises on a plural head noun ('The birds', 'The dogs', 'The cats sat on the mat'), and peaks at the last conjunct of an additive enumeration ('X and Y', 'first, second, and third'), the token at which the count reaches two or more. It reads number rather than predicting the verb: its write leans towards plural agreement (' are', '都是', '这两个' in the Jacobian lens) and away from distributive singular ('每', '的一种'), yet zero-ablating the direction at the peak leaves the next-token distribution almost unchanged (KL <= 0.005); code identifiers ('initializes', 'this') are a separate token-level offshoot that the hypothesis does not claim.
